summary: Correct the root consonant in the detransitive base form
rationale: The root is zwzq and the paired form is mzawzəq; the quoted 93/29 likewise has komzawzəq. The second member unexpectedly substitutes x for the first root z. The comparable pair mzarzəl/mizarzəl in zrzl shows the same mi- formation without changing its root consonants.
